title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the Baltic Sea and ways forward
part_text: 10. Highlights that the creation of additional fish stock recovery areas and area closures, including under the implementation of Natura 2000 and the Nature Restoration Law, requires appropriate stakeholder involvement and must be fully justified on a case-by-case basis by the best available science; highlights the importance of accompanying such measures with appropriate and timely compensation in line with relevant EU provisions;
